source.title: Retiring TNoodle 0.13.3
source.content:
When `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4` was released last week, we announced that `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3` would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since a week has passed, `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3` is now officially retired, leaving `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4` as the only official scramble program.

Please see [last week's `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4`  announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-13-4) for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: 停止使用 TNoodle 0.13.3
translation.content:
上周发布 `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4` 时，我们曾宣布，`TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3` 将在短期内继续作为正式允许使用的版本。现在已过去一周，`TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3` 正式停用，`TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4` 成为唯一的官方打乱程序版本。

详情请参阅[上周的 `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4` 公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-13-4)。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为：
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
translation.revisionReason: 完成当前版本独立审校；正文未改。
